title: Quietness and hard-to-tell states
summary: This topic combines comments about cabin quietness and EV subtlety with unrelated cases where users cannot tell system status, identify navigation entries, manage storage, or complete phone settings tasks.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the vehicle’s very quiet cabin and low road noise.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on missing EV infrastructure limiting overall satisfaction rather than an in-vehicle hearing or identification issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples span unrelated issues including inaudible noise, difficulty telling whether the vehicle is on, EV styling that does not stand out, limited storage, unclear navigation lists, communication problems, and phone deletion workflow confusion.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so the interpretable sentiment signal is limited.
The cluster mixes multiple unrelated subjects linked by phrases like 'cannot hear' and 'cannot tell' rather than a single coherent product issue.
The negative example concerns external charging infrastructure, which may not reflect the same underlying topic as the other fragments.
